# `APPLY_VARIANT_ADD_FAILED`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | error |
| Area | [Apply (`APPLY_`)](README.md#domain-apply) |
| Reported by | `plugin` |

## What happened

A variant could not be added to the existing set without breaking instance links.

## What to do

Retry; if it fails again, Detach the old variant and re-sync (instances of that variant will need swapping).
